content: {"reasoning":"CO-50 supports a medical-necessity appeal; authorization is not required, and neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review is available. Although an appeal was already attempted, no published rule establishes that appeal rights are exhausted, and similar claims favor appeal_with_necessity (4/12 paid) over unchanged submission (1/4). A further appeal should address the payer's invalid CPT–diagnosis pairing using documented clinical evidence rather than unsupported code changes.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
